clips.title: The story
paras: In Duskwood, Skeleton Finger is gathered from the restless dead. Madame Eva of Darkshire collects these remains with ghoul fangs and spider venom to make protective talismans.

The dead rise throughout Duskwood, from skeletal raiders and warriors to necrotic mages and fiends. Most travelers leave their foul remains untouched, but fortune tellers and mystics prize their cold essence. Madame Eva, the seer of Darkshire, gathers the bony fingers to bind their lingering necrotic energies into the Totem of Infliction, a ward that strikes back at attackers.
